look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Climbing tendrilled vine, divided leaflets and inflated papery three-lobed capsules. Open a mature fruit to see three dark rounded seeds, each with a pale heart-shaped scar.
taxonomy_notes: Accepted Cardiospermum halicacabum L. per Master Plant Pool 2026-10-14 name review; do not assume subspecies or merge with C. corindum.

project_inclusion.notes: No new county audit or invasive designation.

morphology_keys.habit: Slender tendrilled climbing vine; numerous hanging papery fruits.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Alternate compound leaves with lobed or divided leaflets.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Small pale flowers; detailed macro still needed.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Inflated papery three-part capsule; round dark seeds with pale heart-shaped hilar mark.
morphology_keys.stem_bud: Thin climbing stems with tendrils; exact node photo needed.

confused_with: Cardiospermum corindum: similar balloonlike fruits; compare capsule and leaflet details using a verified regional key.
Cardiospermum grandiflorum: also inflated fruits; inspect size and surface of mature capsules and flowers.
comparisons.key_distinctions: Use the inflated three-lobed capsule, divided leaves, tendrils and seed scar together; genus look-alikes require a reproductive key.
